what: UBBoost investigation (PR #23239 claimed 2x prefill on RTX 2080 + 35B-A3B): we tested the concept on ALL OUR CPU-offload models. Porting attempt: the POC is a 1894-line parallel-universe server rewrite (codex-generated, unmerged, 5 structural conflicts vs Sept upstream) — measured WITHOUT porting instead: (1) plain -ub sweep (most of the claim's physics is just bigger ubatch), (2) stock slot save/restore cross-runtime shuttle, (3) the ub2048 VRAM wall probe. Protocol: recipe serve flags held constant, only -b/-ub vary, 2 warm runs discarded, 3 measured, fresh 1976-2066-token prompts, server-reported rates.

verdict: 2.4-2.5x prefill from ONE FLAG: 380 -> 930 tok/s. UBBoost's claimed 2x REPRODUCED without any runtime swap — on 8 GB the expert band is already CPU-side so activation VRAM absorbs ub4096. Bonus: warm short-ctx decode measured 39 tok/s (not 20, not 9.3 — cache-warmth dominates this model; the 9.3 recipe row was perf-pressure era, the morning 20 was partial-warm). Subject to re-bench at boosted config.

model: Xing4.0-29B-A4B experts-on-CPU (xing fork host, MTP d2)
verdict: 2.4x prefill: 386 -> 933 tok/s, decode unchanged ~25 (warm). Cleanest monotone of the three.

model: ThinkingCap Q2_K partial-offload dense (ngl 38, MTP d2, docker b11118)
ub2048: OOM at load: 'failed to allocate compute pp buffers' — the VRAM wall exists for dense crams
prefill_boost_profile: ngl 18 + ub 4096 (deep offload to buy activation VRAM): 301 tok/s, loads fine — +115% over the recipe's ub128
verdict: 1.9x on-recipe (ub1024); the wall + the workaround profile is exactly the case UBBoost's runtime swap automates.

what: stock llama.cpp slot save/restore as a UBBoost substitute: prefill in a boost-config server (save: 1976 tokens, 193 MB, 57 ms), restore into the decode-recipe server (32.8 ms) — transfer works cross-instance across DIFFERENT ngl/ubatch. BUT the restored prefill does NOT engage the prompt-cache matcher (n_prompt_tokens_cache 0, next request re-prefills 49 s); empty-prompt continuation rejected 400. Stock restore is state-transport, not cache-reuse — the missing bookkeeping is precisely UBBoost's custom plumbing (save_idle_prompt_state_for_runtime_reload / slot_save_and_clear).

conclusion: the UBBoost claim REPRODUCES on this card for all three CPU-offload classes via the plain -ub lever (2.4x A3B, 2.4x Xing, 1.9x TC), with no port required for the headline. What remains UBBoost-only: (a) the dense-cram VRAM wall case (TC needs the runtime swap to use ub>1024 at ngl 38, or the manual ngl18/ub4096 'cold prefill profile' we measured at 301 tok/s), and (b) automated in-process cache-preserving swaps (stock slot shuttle transfers but cannot resume). Recipe serve lines updated to carry the swept -b/-ub values; AG-Bench re-runs at boosted configs queued to validate agent-level gains.
